statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-57915 is a Kerberos pre-authentication bypass in the Apache Kerby KDC, fixed in Kerby 2.1.2. The kerb-server 1.0.1 classes reported here are shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime 3.3.6 in the druid-ranger-security extension and cannot be upgraded on their own. The latest hadoop-client-runtime (3.5.0) carries kerby-asn1 2.0.3 and no Kerby 2.1.2 copy. Druid does not run a KDC, but reachability of the shaded server classes has not been assessed. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-262p-fj3f-xh7v

CVE-2026-57915 is a Kerberos pre-authentication bypass in the Apache Kerby KDC, fixed in Kerby 2.1.2. The kerb-server 1.0.1 classes reported here are shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime 3.3.6 in the druid-ranger-security extension and cannot be upgraded on their own. The latest hadoop-client-runtime (3.5.0) carries kerby-asn1 2.0.3 and no Kerby 2.1.2 copy. Druid does not run a KDC, but reachability of the shaded server classes has not been assessed. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-262p-fj3f-xh7v

The Kerby 1.0.1 kerb-server classes reported here are copies shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime 3.3.6 and hbase-shaded-client 2.6.0; the image's own Kerby jars are 2.1.2, which includes the fix. No Hadoop or HBase release shades Kerby 2.1.2, and reachability of the shaded copies has not been assessed.
